ownerStatement: Approved by repeat98 on 17 Nov 2026, as relayed by the owner's session that measured Repitch's cost at rest: release Repitch 0.2.1-experimental.
reason: 0.2.1 changes only rate_gate, which now tests the recompute flag before its REPITCH test and takes stock's reuse path at once; on a recompute rp_find returns after the SETUP TSTR byte for OFF, NORM and BEAT. Sites, results and hooks are unchanged: a scratch emulator comparison of 0.2.0 and 0.2.1 over 10,368 increment-builder states and 256 PTCH widget states gave identical registers, track state and output. On the owner's MKII (development twin of base 0.7.8 f24d6e97, 17 Nov 2026, bank C pattern C01 with three static loops on T2-T4, Repitch on no track, npm run device:price, two alternating runs) 0.2.0 added +4.1 and +4.1 points of the frame interrupt and 0.2.1 +2.4 and +2.3; the build measured carried one extra 16-byte routine nothing calls ahead of the voice-renderer detour, so the released package itself was not measured. The UI and pages are 0.1.2's, so its captures are retained. Waived for this exact source: the sound of a REPITCH track on a unit, a track with REPITCH in force on a unit, Part/project reload and power cycles, the MKI, verify_repitch.py and the native gates, chip worst-case cycles and complete memory bounds.
